video_title: 2026-27 Training Camp Media Availability 🎙️ | Ariel Hukporti | 10.01.26

quotes.speaker: Ariel Hukporti
quotes.summary_phrase: Ariel Hukporti on his offensive game and development
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the ball movement has been quite good and training camp has been quite good.
quotes.quote: I feel like the ball movement has been quite good and training camp has been quite good. It's been a positive sense in the sense of getting the ball in the paint and getting my floater in or getting to the rim and just showing more of my finishing and touches.
quotes.social_post: Ariel Hukporti says he is focused on expanding his offensive game during training camp, specifically looking to showcase his floater and finishing ability at the rim.

quotes.speaker: Ariel Hukporti
quotes.summary_phrase: Ariel Hukporti on his long-standing rivalry with Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: We've been playing against each other since we were 14.
quotes.quote: We've been playing against each other since we were 14. I had Franz Wagner, it was me, Franz, I think that's it. And then he had Sengun and himself obviously. We were just battling all the time because Europe, you know, Germany, Turkey, we got some kind of rivalry going on. So we've been playing for a long time, so it's been good seeing him now, seeing him in the league. Last year we had our battles too and now we're on the same team, so it's been nothing but a blessing.
quotes.social_post: Ariel Hukporti reflects on his long history with Joel Embiid, noting they have been battling each other since they were 14 years old in Europe and it is a blessing to finally be on the same team.

quotes.speaker: Ariel Hukporti
quotes.summary_phrase: Ariel Hukporti on team chemistry and playoff readiness
quotes.excerpt: When it comes to an end goal, we're coming together as a team.
quotes.quote: When it comes to an end goal, we're coming together as a team and you produce as a team. It don't matter. It can be me playing five minutes, him playing 15 minutes, me playing 25, him playing 15 minutes. It don't matter. Whoever gets in, gets in, getting that job done. And then, especially in the playoffs, we need everybody. We need all players.
quotes.social_post: Ariel Hukporti emphasizes the importance of team depth for the Sixers, stating that when it comes to the playoffs, it does not matter who gets the minutes as long as everyone is ready to get the job done.

quotes.speaker: Ariel Hukporti
quotes.summary_phrase: Ariel Hukporti on learning from Joel Embiid's defensive game
quotes.excerpt: It just makes me way better as a defender and I make him better too.
quotes.quote: For me personally, it was more about patience. I feel like he has a great offensive game when it comes to patience, getting in the air, getting to his spots. But yeah, it just makes me way better as a defender and I make him better too as an offensive player. The post game is quite impressive, so we're definitely taking that from him.
quotes.social_post: Ariel Hukporti says practicing against Joel Embiid is making him a better defender, specifically highlighting how he is learning from Embiid's patience and footwork in the post.

quotes.speaker: Ariel Hukporti
quotes.summary_phrase: Ariel Hukporti on championship culture and team similarities
quotes.excerpt: Championship mentality, I didn't expect nothing less.
quotes.quote: It's obviously a different team. We got obviously more superstars, but the approach is actually quite the same. Championship mentality, I didn't expect nothing less.
quotes.social_post: Ariel Hukporti says the approach in Philadelphia is defined by a championship mentality, noting that despite the star power on the roster, the team culture remains focused on winning.
